    @storage = {}
  end

  # We store a tuple of [payload, is_stale] to track the stale status.

      # Use the packer to serialize the tuple
      @storage[key] = @packer.dump(data)

class AttrParser
  def self.parse(line)
    # Regular expression explanation:
    # ([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*) : Captures the key (starts with alpha/underscore, followed by alphanumeric/underscore)
    # =                       : Matches the equals sign
    # "                       : Matches the opening quote
    # (.*?)                   : Non-greedy capture of the value (everything until the first closing quote)
    # "                       : Matches the closing quote
    pattern = /([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)="(.*?)"/
    
    results = {}
    
    # scan returns an array of pairs [[key1, val1], [key2, val2], ...]
    line.scan(pattern).each do |key, value|
      results[key.to_sym] = value
    end
    
    results
  end
end
